purpose: Primary-source material-field evidence for Norway higher-education study permit route.
policy: Only exact route claims supported by current official sources are included; promotion requires complete material-field coverage and matching pathway scope.

records.claim: A person from outside the EU/EEA who plans to study in Norway for more than three months must apply for a study residence permit; for higher education the applicant must be admitted to a university college or university and study full-time, in addition to the other applicable requirements.
records.methodology: Direct review of current UDI study-permit guidance and higher-education requirements.

records.claim: For higher-education study permit applicants, UDI states that the applicant must document at least NOK 15,488 per month, or NOK 170,368 per year, for the academic year; semester-specific documentation is also specified for applicants studying for only one semester.
records.methodology: Direct review of current UDI higher-education study-permit financial requirement.
